privacy.noLiveAdsState: No data collected by this app; no tracking; no account; progress and settings stay local.
privacy.liveAdsState: Review Google Mobile Ads SDK privacy report and disclose ad SDK data collection before APP_STORE_PRIVACY_ANSWERS_REVIEWED=1.

review.notes: Kana Sprint does not require sign-in. Reviewers can start a practice run directly, switch N5-N1 difficulty, open Settings for language and music, and use the rewarded-ad continue entry point when production AdMob IDs are configured.

compliance.tracking: No tracking by app code; final IDFA/tracking answer must match live AdMob SDK behavior and ATT decision.
compliance.ads: Rewarded ad entry exists; local AdMob integration ready; live ads disabled until production AdMob IDs are valid.
